text: As a child, Theo was fascinated by the stars and spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home. This love for astronomy was more than just a hobby; it was a bond with his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. He often looked up not just at the distant suns, but at the soft, white clouds drifting above, knowing that those fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, just as he knew his mother’s legacy was the foundation of his own dreams.
